series.blurb: On his first day at a new job, Luca has to give something to a Mr Rossi, and nobody seems to know who Mr Rossi is.
Luca has just moved to Via Verdi, and every day a stranger stands in the street and watches his house.
Money keeps vanishing from Sara's family home, and her little brother Tommaso is acting very strangely.
Luca's sister Anna finds a phone in the street, and the messages that keep arriving sound like a secret plan.
Every morning at ten a quiet lady sits in Gino's bar and writes in a little book, and Piero cannot stop wondering what she writes.
Over coffee at Gino's bar, Piero tells Elena the story of his life: a village by the sea, a red dress, a long silence.
Piero takes the train back to his seaside village after a lifetime away, with his son, his grandson and Elena, to find his old friend Franco.
On Sara's first week at a small publisher, the only copy of a secret new novel vanishes from the boss's desk, and she is the obvious suspect.
Building work at Gino's bar uncovers a metal box hidden in a wall for sixty years, and the whole of Via Verdi sets out to deliver a letter that never arrived.

sentences.en: "But I don't know if she'll want to talk about the past," she adds. "She never talks about it."

sentences.it: Luca chiama subito Gino per dargli la notizia.
sentences.en: Luca calls Gino straight away to give him the news.

sentences.it: Quella sera Gino guarda a lungo la busta chiusa.
sentences.en: That evening Gino looks at the sealed envelope for a long time.

sentences.it: «Domani questa lettera arriverà finalmente alla persona giusta», dice. «Con molti anni di ritardo.»
sentences.en: "Tomorrow this letter will finally reach the right person," he says. "Many years late."

sentences.it: La signora Fiore li aspetta in giardino, seduta al sole, con una coperta sulle gambe.
sentences.en: Mrs Fiore is waiting for them in the garden, sitting in the sun, with a blanket over her legs.

sentences.it: Ha i capelli bianchi, ma gli occhi sono gli occhi della ragazza della fotografia.
sentences.en: Her hair is white, but her eyes are the eyes of the girl in the photograph.

sentences.it: Gino si avvicina per primo.
sentences.en: Gino goes up to her first.

sentences.it: «Signora, mi chiamo Gino. Sono il nipote di Rinaldo Bassi.»
sentences.en: "Madam, my name is Gino. I'm Rinaldo Bassi's grandson."

sentences.it: Marta lo guarda a lungo, senza dire niente.
sentences.en: Marta looks at him for a long time, without saying anything.

sentences.it: «Rinaldo», dice alla fine. «È un nome che non sento da molto tempo.»
sentences.en: "Rinaldo," she says at last. "That's a name I haven't heard for a long time."

sentences.it: Gino le dà la scatola di metallo.
sentences.en: Gino gives her the metal box.

sentences.it: Marta tocca il metallo freddo con le dita, come per capire se è vero.
sentences.en: Marta touches the cold metal with her fingers, as if to check it's real.

sentences.it: Marta prende la fotografia e la tiene vicino al viso.
sentences.en: Marta takes the photograph and holds it close to her face.

sentences.it: «Questa sono io. L'ha fatta lui, il giorno del mio compleanno.»
sentences.en: "That's me. He took it, on my birthday."

sentences.it: Poi vede la busta, e riconosce la mano di Rinaldo.
sentences.en: Then she sees the envelope, and recognises Rinaldo's hand.

sentences.it: Le sue mani tremano mentre apre la busta.
sentences.en: Her hands tremble as she opens the envelope.

sentences.it: Legge la lettera a voce alta, piano:
sentences.en: She reads the letter aloud, slowly:

sentences.it: «Cara Marta, stanotte mio padre è stato male, e il medico dice che è grave.
sentences.en: "Dear Marta, tonight my father was taken ill, and the doctor says it's serious.

sentences.it: Non posso lasciarlo da solo, e non posso lasciare il bar.
sentences.en: I can't leave him on his own, and I can't leave the bar.

sentences.it: Domani tu partirai, e io non sarò sulla nave con te.
sentences.en: Tomorrow you will leave, and I won't be on the ship with you.

sentences.it: Non ho il coraggio di dirtelo guardandoti negli occhi.
sentences.en: I don't have the courage to tell you looking into your eyes.

sentences.it: Così lascio questa lettera nel nostro posto segreto, dietro la parete, dove ci lasciavamo i messaggi.
sentences.en: So I'm leaving this letter in our secret place, behind the wall, where we used to leave each other messages.

sentences.it: Se la troverai, saprai che ti ho amata, e che ti amerò sempre. R.»
sentences.en: If you find it, you'll know that I loved you, and that I will always love you. R."

sentences.it: Per un lungo momento in giardino c'è solo silenzio.
sentences.en: For a long moment there's only silence in the garden.

sentences.it: Poi Marta alza gli occhi.
sentences.en: Then Marta looks up.

sentences.it: «Quella mattina ho aspettato fino all'ultimo minuto. Poi sono salita sulla nave da sola.
sentences.en: "That morning I waited until the last minute. Then I got on the ship on my own.

sentences.it: Ero così piena di rabbia che non sono mai andata a guardare nel nostro posto segreto.
sentences.en: I was so full of anger that I never went to look in our secret place.

sentences.it: Per una vita intera ho pensato che non mi amava.»
sentences.en: For a whole lifetime I thought he didn't love me."

sentences.it: Guarda Gino e sorride. «Hai i suoi occhi, lo sai?»
sentences.en: She looks at Gino and smiles. "You have his eyes, you know?"

sentences.it: Un mese dopo, il bar di via Verdi apre di nuovo.
sentences.en: A month later, the bar on Via Verdi opens again.

sentences.it: Sulla parete, dove c'era il buco, ora c'è la fotografia di Marta davanti alla porta del bar.
sentences.en: On the wall, where the hole was, there's now the photograph of Marta in front of the door of the bar.

sentences.it: Marta è seduta al primo tavolo, con un caffè e un sorriso.
sentences.en: Marta is sitting at the first table, with a coffee and a smile.

sentences.it: Vicino a lei, Elena scrive l'ultima frase del suo libro:
sentences.en: Next to her, Elena writes the last sentence of her book:

sentences.it: «Le lettere, a volte, arrivano tardi. Ma arrivano.»
sentences.en: "Letters sometimes arrive late. But they do arrive."
